w: The morning celebration of Bhagatji Maharaj's birthday celebration was held on the mandir ground. After a couple of discourses and bhajans the assembly was blessed by Swamishri. He said, "Bhagatji Maharaj had a single goal; and that was to please Gunatitanand Swami. Whatever Swami commanded he followed with 100% faith. He had no doubt in the Swami's words as to why he had said that, and how will it be done?

"There are two principal things for us, agna and upasana. And Bhagatji Maharaj had imbibed and consolidated that in his life. The more agna one follows, the more happiness one experiences within. He had it firmly embedded in his life because he had spiritual associated with Gunatitanand Swami and Gopalanand Swami. In order to please Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj had to go through a number of sufferings and problems. But he overcame them all because he had one goal - to achieve Akshardham. Similarly, if we have a single goal then no matter what tribulations, difficulties or in-sults come our way we will not be disturbed, we will not find fault in Satsang, in a sadhu or a devotee and our mind will never fall back..."
A convention of chhatralay alumni was held. Several students narrated their experiences and benefits of having stayed in the chhatralay. In conclusion, Swamishri blessed the convention.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for hari mandirs in the villages of Sujanpur, Paliyad and Mokhasan.
In the evening satsang assembly the devotees honored Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

In the evening Sunday satsang assembly Swamishri and senior sadhus blessed and honoured Dr Ashwinbhai Mehta, Dr Hunda, Inspector General of Police Shri Barve, Dr K.N. Patel, Dr Kiran Doshi and Yogicharan Swami. First, senior sadhus garlanded Swamishri and thereafter Kothari Swami garlanded all the doctors and presented shawls. Swamishri presented an Amrut Kalash as mementos to all the guests. In his blessings Swamishri appreciated the services of the doctors, and then elaborated upon the meaning of maya. “Whatever obstructs one from God’s bhajan is called maya. Maya means I-ness and Mine-ness. When such feelings arise for money, property and relatives – that is maya. When one sees with atmic vision there is no I-ness and Mine-ness.”

13-18 March 2008 , (V.S. 2064, ) Bhavnagar During Swamishri’s stay in Bhavnagar devotees had darshan of Swamishri’s morning puja and blessings during Sunday satsang assembly. Every evening Viveksagar Swami expounded upon the prayer ‘Maha balvant maya...’ by women devotees of North Gujarat to Shriji Maharaj during a Fuldol Festival in Sarangpur (fagva).
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis to be installed at the BAPS hari mandirs in Bareja and Kaaligam (re- pratishtha of renovated hari mandir, Ahmedabad).
Swamishri came into the assembly hall for puja. Meanwhile Ramjibhai, who had come from Kampala, began as every day to sing the chhadi: "Golden staff, diamond torch, best of the best..."
Hearing this, Swamishri said, "Who else used to say 'best of the best' like this?"
Swamishri said, "Yes, that is right. He always used to say this."
In this way too, Swamishri remembered the loving words of an old devoted devotee.
Swamishri was having his meal. Haridarshan Swami and other sadhus who had come from America described how touring was going there and spoke of the devotees' dedication.

Hearing this, Swamishri said, "For the devotees to be happy is a very great thing. Satsangis are our farmland. Through them Thakorji's seva happens. Once devotees have faith and love, nothing more needs to be said to them."
Haridarshan Swami said, "In fact the devotees have no other expectations. Everyone is very dedicated."

Swamishri said, "The devotee may have no expectation, but we must keep the habit of serving them. We must build this nature. Not everyone is the same, so if sometimes we do not call or speak to someone, he may fall back. Once faith is firm, there is no problem. Yogiji Maharaj kept so much: he would call and talk with devotees, play with them, feed them, have them fetched right from the gate. His nature was just like that.

In the same way, build the habit of discourses. Doctor Swami is like this. With so many physical troubles and at his age, how many discourses he gives! Ten times a day. Mahant Swami's health is also like that. Viveksagar Swami, Tyagvallabh Swami, Kothari Swami, Ishwar Swami, all of them are like this. It has become firm in their souls, so they cannot stay without discourses and seva."
